## Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is (e.g. *I am unable to...*).

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how the new feature should work.

## Alternatives Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## UI/UX Mockups or Details (If Applicable)
Describe or attach sketches/mockups of how the feature should look in the UniMap interface.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, user stories, or technical details about the feature request here.
